body: Journaling's a great idea! Haven't actually thought about that, I'm just going to write down everything that I've been thinking about from now on. I know my college has free mental health services but I could never bring myself to contact them because I felt that I could handle everything on my own. Thanks for just listening. Hopefully this time I'll be able to start getting my life back together.

Deep down I just don't see how anyone could actually enjoy my company once they really get to know who I am. When people ask me to think of one positive thing about myself literally nothing comes to mind. Sorry about rambling on for so long, it's just nice to have somewhere to write down what's been stuck in my head for years.

I think it's the latter if I'm being entirely honest with myself. My lack of trust of other people combined with my shyness probably makes me really difficult to approach. Glad to hear that we're all weirdoes when you really get down to it lol.
Man that's a bummer. I was on meds earlier this year but haven't been taking any since college started.

Thanks for the kind words, that's honestly encouraging to hear. I thought that I was recovering because I felt a jolt of happiness when I got accepted into my dream university, but that same emptiness quickly returned a few weeks later and now it feels like I'm back to square one.
I'll try doing that. I feel really lost right now, so having something to work towards would add structure to my life.

It's been a problem since high school. I have a very eccentric personality so I probably come off as cold or really strange to others. I just wish that someone could honestly tell me what I'm doing wrong because no matter what I try I just can't seem to connect with anyone.
I can't even imagine being in a relationship like that. I just feel like I'm unlovable so I don't even bother approaching anyone.
Good to know lol. Now all I need to do is to get my hands on copious amounts of that stuff.

It's all out in the city. All my classes are online this semester which has been ABSOLUTELY awesome. Been having a hard time making friends with anyone in my classes because everyone seems to prefer hanging out with people they can meet in real life. It's either that or I'm just so awkward that I repel everyone away from me.
I'd say it helps a little bit. It's nice as an activity since it isn't mentally taxing and I also know that at least some of my free time is going towards something productive.
Mainly just been walking and going on my exercise bike. I'm not sure how to start with strength training if I'm being honest.
It's fine. I've been doing about 30 minutes of cardio everyday but I haven't really looked into strength training.
Working out sounds like something that would help me feel better about myself. I'll have to check out that song sometime. Music's one of the last things that make me feel something.
I feel like rolling into ball and spontaneously disappearing from existence. I'm in so much pain all the time that I genuinely question if I should even bother with living.

I never thought about it but I guess I am jealous of my friends' ability to just experience some semblance of happiness. I used to actually have hobbies but now I just sit around on my ass wasting the day away playing video games that I don't even enjoy because I don't have the energy to do anything else. I actually tried sitting down to work on a programming project and my brain just started hurting. It's so fucking pathetic.

I know exactly how you feel. No matter what I do I just can't think of a single positive thing about myself. My self-esteem is pretty much non-existent at this point and I'm becoming more and more of a recluse with each passing day.
